verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a local API (localhost, offline) with endpoints for creating/editing/querying objects, plus an official MCP server that converts the OpenAPI spec into MCP tools for AI assistants to read/search/modify Objects, and an 'agents skill' for headless scripting via Claude Code/Cursor/etc. This directly satisfies headless read/write access without touching the GUI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP server/API working reliably (community evidence is mostly about general UX, not the API/MCP specifically) and no third-party corroboration of the OpenAPI-to-MCP pipeline in practice.
